answer: Each identity enrols a voiceprint by reading a fresh phrase issued by the beacon; a speaker-verification model checks voice and phrase together, blocking replay. The voiceprint hashes with the epoch seed into a nullifier, and enrolment locks a 20 POA bond, slashed if two identities share one voice. The zenith of confidence needs three liveness sessions per epoch; a farm must hire a live speaker per identity at $15 a session, so the nth fake costs more, not less. A ferrous binding adds a device key, so one microphone cannot mint a crowd. Limits: deepfakes improve yearly; pair with human review.
